topic: Negros são maioria entre empreendedores de Pernambuco, mas recebem 78% menos que brancos Notícia Preta Brasil
insights: In Pernambuco, black entrepreneurs make up 62.3% of the entrepreneurial landscape but earn significantly less than their white counterparts.
The average income for black entrepreneurs in Pernambuco is R$ 2,334.28, while white entrepreneurs earn R$ 4,155.25.
The income disparity between black and white entrepreneurs in Pernambuco is 78%, highlighting systemic economic inequalities.
